name: Compressed Multi-Head Attention for DistilBERT and Multi-Architecture via J
description: Compressed Multi-Head Attention for DistilBERT and Multi-Architecture via Joint Truncated SVD.  Performs joint singular value decomposition on stacked query, key, and value projection matrices as well as the final output projection matrix with frozen base parameters, trainable LoRA residual adapters, GQA, RoPE, causal decoding, and full pretrained weight transfer.

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
